lines.text_int: WE did it, Ratchet.  All of us.
Many brothers were lost today... but thanks to our combined efforts, many more will live to find a home elsewhere.
lines.text_fra: Nombre de nos frères sont tombés... Mais grâce à nos efforts combinés, d'autres vont fuir et trouver une nouvelle patrie.

lines.text_int: And as long as we remain here, we shall resist him. But in time, our turn will come to leave Cybertron as well.
lines.text_fra: Et tant que nous serons là, nous lui résisterons. Mais un jour, nous devrons quitter Cybertron nous aussi.

lines.text_int: I have commissioned a new galactic transport for us...an Ark, in which we shall make our journey through the stars.
lines.text_fra: J'ai commandité un nouveau transport galactique... une Arche, qui nous permettra de voyager à travers les étoiles.

lines.text_int: No matter where we go, Cybertron will be with us.
lines.text_fra: Où que nous allions, Cybertron sera avec nous.
